mapper.sql: id, task_id, step_order, status, timer_type, duration_seconds, started_time, paused_time, total_paused_seconds, remaining_seconds, completed_time, create_time, last_modify_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM cooking_task_step WHERE task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY step_order ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE cooking_task_step SET status = 'RUNNING', started_time = NOW(), paused_time = NULL, total_paused_seconds = 0, remaining_seconds = CASE WHEN timer_type = 'countdown' THEN duration_seconds ELSE NULL END, completed_time = NULL, last_modify_time = NOW() WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND step_order = #{stepOrder} AND status = 'PENDING'

UPDATE cooking_task_step SET status = 'PAUSED', remaining_seconds = CASE WHEN timer_type = 'countdown' AND duration_seconds IS NOT NULL AND started_time IS NOT NULL THEN GREATEST(0, duration_seconds - (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - started_time))::int - total_paused_seconds)) ELSE remaining_seconds END, paused_time = NOW(), last_modify_time = NOW() WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND step_order = #{stepOrder} AND status = 'RUNNING'

UPDATE cooking_task_step SET status = 'RUNNING', total_paused_seconds = total_paused_seconds + CASE WHEN paused_time IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE GREATEST(0, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - paused_time))::int) END, paused_time = NULL, last_modify_time = NOW() WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND step_order = #{stepOrder} AND status = 'PAUSED'

UPDATE cooking_task_step SET status = 'DONE', started_time = COALESCE(started_time, NOW()), total_paused_seconds = total_paused_seconds + CASE WHEN paused_time IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE GREATEST(0, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - paused_time))::int) END, paused_time = NULL, remaining_seconds = CASE WHEN timer_type = 'countdown' THEN 0 ELSE remaining_seconds END, completed_time = NOW(), last_modify_time = NOW() WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND step_order = #{stepOrder} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING', 'PAUSED')

UPDATE cooking_task_step SET status = 'PENDING', started_time = NULL, paused_time = NULL, total_paused_seconds = 0, remaining_seconds = CASE WHEN timer_type = 'countdown' THEN duration_seconds ELSE NULL END, completed_time = NULL, last_modify_time = NOW() WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND step_order = #{stepOrder} AND status = 'DONE'

UPDATE cooking_task_step SET status = 'PAUSED', remaining_seconds = CASE WHEN timer_type = 'countdown' AND duration_seconds IS NOT NULL AND started_time IS NOT NULL THEN GREATEST(0, duration_seconds - (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - started_time))::int - total_paused_seconds)) ELSE remaining_seconds END, paused_time = NOW(), last_modify_time = NOW() WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND status = 'RUNNING'

UPDATE cooking_task_step SET status = 'RUNNING', total_paused_seconds = total_paused_seconds + CASE WHEN paused_time IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE GREATEST(0, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - paused_time))::int) END, paused_time = NULL, last_modify_time = NOW() WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND status = 'PAUSED'

UPDATE cooking_task_step SET status = 'DONE', started_time = COALESCE(started_time, NOW()), total_paused_seconds = total_paused_seconds + CASE WHEN paused_time IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE GREATEST(0, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - paused_time))::int) END, paused_time = NULL, remaining_seconds = CASE WHEN timer_type = 'countdown' THEN 0 ELSE remaining_seconds END, completed_time = NOW(), last_modify_time = NOW() WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND status IN ('RUNNING', 'PAUSED')
